scope: Proposition 3.7 (Central determinant formula) of the manuscript “A pointwise 2-converse for elliptic curves with rational two-torsion” (preprints/A-pointwise-2-converse-for-elliptic-curves-with-rational-two-torsion-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 004 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 df42f33f68fbef77), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a constant Cloc, depending only on the fixed curve and local classes, with the following property. If s2(E(hx)) = 0, then ux(0) = 0 when L(E(hx), 1) = 0. Otherwise ⃓ ⃓v2(ux(0)) − D(hx) ⃓ ⃓ ≤ Cloc. (3.13) The rational positive complex at t = 0 has cohomology only in degree one, of dimension two, so these are specializations of the same determinant.
